model_annotation: The slides contain three sets of bar charts from the "19 Chinese Mobile Linguistic Conference Document Article," pages 308-314, August 5, 2023, Beijing, China, from the Chinese Linguistics Science Committee. The charts illustrate the proportion of verb phrases used in different contexts by mobile language, such as verbs indicating living work, living activities, and formal speeches. The charts are labeled in Chinese, and the data is presented in a vertical format. The charts are accompanied by text that discusses the implications of mobile language use and the shift in gender roles in conversation over time. The text also mentions the influence of media on social conventions and gender perceptions. The slide includes the conference name, date, location, and publication details at the bottom.
